commands.check: Check the PWA of every view

tools.check: The web app manifest, icons, service worker, offline test and installability of the pages the views show, with findings.
tools.icon: One icon of a view's origin as a data: URI with its real size and format.

offline.not_cached: Start URL cached for offline use

manifest.missing: The page links no web app manifest (<link rel="manifest">), so it cannot be installed.
manifest.content_type: The manifest is served as {type}; serve it as application/manifest+json.
manifest.invalid: The manifest is no valid JSON object: {error}
manifest.name: The manifest has neither a name nor a short_name.
manifest.start_url: The manifest has no usable start_url ({reason}), so the app starts at whatever page was installed.
manifest.display: The manifest's display is {display}: use standalone, fullscreen or minimal-ui so the app opens in a window of its own.
manifest.icon_size: The manifest declares no icon of {size}x{size} px.

fetch.other_origin: The {what} at {url} lies on another origin than the page and was not checked.

icons.not_image: The icon {src} is no PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, ICO or SVG image.
icons.size_mismatch: The icon {src} is {actual} px, not {declared} as its sizes say.
icons.type_mismatch: The icon {src} is {actual}, not {declared} as its type says.

start_url.out_of_scope: The start URL {url} lies outside the scope {scope}.

sw.insecure: The page is no secure context (HTTPS or localhost), so it cannot have a service worker.
sw.missing: No service worker is registered for this page.
sw.not_active: The service worker is registered but not active ({state}).
sw.not_controlling: The service worker is active but does not control this page yet; reload it.
sw.fetch_handler: The service worker {script} has no fetch handler, so nothing is served offline.

offline.not_cached: The service worker's caches do not hold the start URL {url}, so the app will not open offline.

install.error: Chromium reports the page is not installable: {error} {details}

meta.theme_color: The page has no <meta name="theme-color">, so the title bar keeps the browser's colour.
meta.apple_touch_icon: The page has no <link rel="apple-touch-icon">, so iOS uses a screenshot as the home screen icon.

enabled.label: Offline test
enabled.description: With an active service worker, ask its caches whether they hold the start URL, so the app opens offline.
enabled.help: With an active service worker, asks its caches whether they hold the start URL, so the app opens offline. When off, it skips the offline test.

timeoutMs.label: Time limit of one check
timeoutMs.description: No further request (icons, start URL, service worker script) once one check has run this long, in milliseconds.
timeoutMs.help: No further request (icons, start URL, service worker script) once one check has run this long, in milliseconds. Example: 30000.

panel.reported: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} sent to the findings panel.
panel.empty: No Chromium view shows a web page.
panel.cut: The answer was shortened; MCP pwa_check gives all of it.
panel.summary: {error, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}}, {warning, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}, {info, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}
panel.noFindings: No findings: the page meets every rule.

icons.safeZone: The circle is the maskable safe zone (80 %).
icons.tooLarge: Larger than the panel can show ({bytes, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}}).
